resources.string: Kuphenya ngelikheli akukatfolakali kulomphakeli. Khetsa liqembu ohlwini.
Tatiso ngekucisha kwegesi lokutako emakhelini lakhetsiwe

I-Light i-app yekubuka tinhlelo tekucisha kwegesi e-Ukraine. Gcina likhaya lakho, indzawo yakho yekusebenta nalenye indzawo lebalulekile kuze ubone tinhlelo tanamuhla nekusasa futsi uhlele lilanga lakho.

Engeta indzawo: khetsa sifundza sakho, umphakeli wegesi neliqembu lekucisha. Khetsa libito nesithonjana. Sikrini sasekhaya sikhombisa luhlelo lwemahafu ehora, luphawu lwesikhatsi samanje nesikhatsi sekugcina kubuyekezwa. Tonkhe tinhlelo tisebentisa sikhatsi se-Kyiv.

Endzaweni ngayinye, khetsa kutsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lemingaki ngaphambi kwekucisha ufuna kukhunjutwa. Likhetho “Ungangihlupheli ebusuku” liyathulisa tikhumbuto kusuka nge-23:00 kuya nge-07:00. Vumela tatiso kutilungiselelo te-Android. Sikhatsi sekufika sincike emvumeni yesistimu nasetithibelweni setifo.

Engeta i-widget kusikrini sasekhaya kuze ubone luhlelo ngaphandle kwekuvula i-app futsi ushintshe emkhatsini wanamuhla nekusasa. Tinhlelo letilandziwe tigcinwa kusifo sakho futsi tihlala tikhona ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi. Kudzingeka kuxhumana ne-inthanethi kuze utfole imininingwane lemisha.

I-app ilanda tinhlelo letishicilelwe ku-API ye-YASNO nasetindzaweni letivuliwe tekugcina imininingwane yekucisha kwegesi. Luhlelo lwekusasa luvela emva kwekutsi sinsika silushicilele. Kucacile kwalo kuncike kulezo tinsika, futsi imininingwane legciniwe ingaphelelwa sikhatsi. Ngesikhatsi sekucisha kwegesi kwesimo lesiphutfumako, gesi weneliciniso ungahluka kuluhlelo.

Tindzawo letigciniwe netilungiselelo tigcinwa endzaweni kusifo sakho. I-app isebentisa i-Firebase kuhlaziya kusetjentiswa, imibiko yekuphuka kwe-app nemilayeto yesevisi. Emabito etindzawo letigciniwe awengetwa etehlakalweni tekuhlaziya noma emibikweni yekuphuka kwe-app.
Engeta likheli kuze ubone luhlelo lwalo lwekucisha kwegesi

Kucisha kwegesi kwesimo lesiphutfumako kwethulwe ngumyalo we-NPC Ukrenergo. Tinhlelo tekucisha kwegesi ngeke tisebente ngesikhatsi sekucisha kwesimo lesiphutfumako. Sicela usebentise gesi ngekuhlakanipha kuze usite kuzinzisa inethiwekhi yegesi. Siyabonga ngekutsisisa kwakho!
Imininingwane iphelelwe sikhatsi. Sinsika singahle singabuyekezi luhlelo uma kungekho kucisha kwegesi.
Akukho luhlelo lolugciniwe. Donsela phansi kuze uvuselele.

Kubuyekezwa kulandziwe. Vula i-app kabusha kuze uyifake.
Kuvikelwa kukhawulelwe kubasebenti labalisiwe netindzawo tabo tesevisi.
Khetsa lidolobha nesitalada emiphumelweni, bese ufaka linombolo yendlu. Faka tinhlavu letingenani kwemitsatfu kuze uphenye.
Lensika igcinelwe kudzala futsi ayisashicileli tinhlelo tamanje.
Kukhombisa lemininingwane kudzinga imvume yemphakeli. Sicela usebentise lisayithi lemphakeli.
Imininingwane yamanje ayikhoni kutfolwa ngekwayo okwamanje. Hlola lisayithi lemsebenti.
Tinhlelo titfolakala elisayithini lemsebenti. Kutfola ngekwako akuxhunyiwe.
Ayikhoni kulayisha imininingwane. Zama futsi noma uvule lisayithi lemsebenti.
Akukho timo letifanelanako letibuyisiwe. Loku akukuniketi sitsembiso sekutsi gesi uyatfolakala.
Simo sendzawo. Hlola kutsi singabe siyayithinta yini impahla yakho.
Mpunga usho kutsi akukho mininingwane. Mphofu usho kutsi kucisha kugoqa ingcenye yehhafu yehora noma ihora lephindzwayo leklogo. Tikhatsi letiqondzile tikhonjisiwe ngentasi.
Faka indzawo yakho noma ikhodi yeposi. Khetsa indzawo kukucisha kwamanje, noma ucindzetele Lelandzelako kuze usebentise ikhodi yakho yeposi.

Likhadi alikhoni kugcinwa. Sicela uzame futsi.
Tinketho takho tetatiso titawugcinwa. Tatiso letenta ngekwato atikatfolakali kulomsebenti.
